critique: The fire-colored sprite texture and black background are appropriate, and the particle count increases between frames. However, both frames still read as a symmetric radial burst centered in the comp: particles and large flame chunks spread in all directions, with no coherent rocket travel axis or attached tapered fire trail. By frame 4 the very large isolated sprites near the edges make the effect feel like an explosion/debris field rather than the compact directional Rocket Fire preset.

suggestions.why: Rotate the directional emitter into the visible comp plane so the emission forms a clear rocket-fire travel axis instead of appearing as a face-on radial spread.
Greatly narrow directional spread to consolidate particles into a tapered jet/trail rather than a circular explosion.
Reduce velocity so particles remain visually connected as a flame trail over the sampled frames instead of immediately reaching the comp edges.
Increase continuous emission density so the directional trail reads as sustained fire rather than sparse individual dots and disconnected sprites.
Shrink maximum sprite size to prevent the oversized flame chunks at the frame edges from dominating the rocket-fire shape.
